source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Reflecting on Collaborative Experiences (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: Project mukammal karne ke baad talaba ke liye faida-mand hai ke sochein kya achha hua aur kya behtar ho sakta tha. Reflection (ghaur o fikr) team members ko taqat, jaise achhi communication, aur kamzoriyan, jaise deadline se reh jana, pehchanne deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Project ke baad reflection (ghaur) mein kya dekhna chahiye? Aik strength aur aik weakness ki misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Kya achha hua aur kya behtar ho sakta tha. Strength: achhi communication; weakness: deadlines (aakhri tareekh) miss hona.

items: Reflection: project ke baad achhi aur kamzor baaton ki pehchan.
